title: Behavioral RED: alertness far below your normal
todo: Content drafted by the team, NOT medically reviewed. Must be reviewed by a flight surgeon / NASA HRP source before any real use. Add source_title/source_url when verified.

n1.text: Are you scheduled for a safety-critical task in the next 6 hours?

n2.text: Hand the task to a crewmate or postpone it until you have re-tested within your normal range.

n3.text: Rest: take a nap of up to 20 minutes, then repeat the reaction test.

n4.text: Prepare a summary for the flight surgeon at the next comm window.

end.text: Avoid critical tasks until a re-test is back near your baseline.
